const imageBlobCache=new Map();
async function cachedImageBlob(url){
 if(!imageBlobCache.has(url)){
   imageBlobCache.set(url,(async()=>{
     const response=await fetch(url,{mode:'cors',cache:'force-cache'});
     if(!response.ok)throw Error('image HTTP '+response.status);
     const blob=await response.blob();
     if(!blob.type.startsWith('image/'))throw Error('invalid image');
     return blob;
   })());
 }
 return imageBlobCache.get(url);
}
async function photoToInline(url,variant=0){
 try{
   const blob=await cachedImageBlob(url);
   if(!blob.type.startsWith('image/'))throw Error('invalid image');
   const image=await createImageBitmap(blob);
   const factor=Math.min(1,840/Math.max(image.width,image.height));
   const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
   canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(image.width*factor));
   canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(image.height*factor));
   const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
   if(variant===0)ctx.drawImage(image,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
   else{
     const crops=[
       {scale:.83,x:.12,y:.15},
       {scale:.72,x:.82,y:.72},
       {scale:.9,x:.62,y:.22},
       {scale:.76,x:.22,y:.78},
       {scale:.88,x:.5,y:.5}
     ];
     const crop=crops[(variant-1)%crops.length];
     const w=image.width*crop.scale,h=image.height*crop.scale;
     const x=(image.width-w)*crop.x,y=(image.height-h)*crop.y;
     ctx.drawImage(image,x,y,w,h,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
   }
   image.close?.();
   const data=canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.64);
   return data.length<1500000?data:'';
 }catch(err){console.warn('Demo asset unavailable:',url,err);return ''}
}

 }else if(id==='saas'){
  ctx.fillStyle=ink;ctx.fillRect(110,140,740,450);
  ctx.fillStyle='#f8fcf8';ctx.fillRect(123,153,714,425);
  ctx.fillStyle=tone;ctx.fillRect(150,180,135,360);
  ctx.fillStyle=ink;ctx.font='700 23px sans-serif';ctx.fillText('OVERVIEW',326,220);
  for(let j=0;j<4;j++){ctx.fillStyle=j%2?highlight:bg;ctx.fillRect(320+(j%2)*235,250+Math.floor(j/2)*135,205,114);
   ctx.strokeStyle=tone;ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.strokeRect(320+(j%2)*235,250+Math.floor(j/2)*135,205,114)}

  for(let j=0;j<4;j++){const x=95+j*207,y=180+(j%2)*70;

 ctx.fillText('MOTION STUDIO / ORIGINAL ARTWORK',54,51);
 ctx.font='500 15px sans-serif';ctx.fillText(String(index+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+id.toUpperCase(),54,677);

async function ensureTemplatePhoto(id){
 if(templatePhotoCache.has(id))return templatePhotoCache.get(id);
 if(templatePhotoPending.has(id))return templatePhotoPending.get(id);
 const primary=templateThumbnailImages[id];
 const extras=(templateExtraPhotos[id]||[]).map(photo=>`https://images.unsplash.com/${photo}?w=1000&q=75`);
 const count=templateSets[id]?.sections.length||0;
 const onlineSources=[primary,...extras].map(source=>({media:source,source}));
 const sources=templateOfflinePhotoBundles[id]||onlineSources;
 const job=Promise.all(Array.from({length:count},async(_,index)=>{
    const candidate=sources[index]||null;
    const photo=candidate?.media?await photoToInline(candidate.media):'';
    return {image:photo||authoredChapterArtwork(id,index),
      kind:photo?'unsplash-photo':'original-generated-art',
      source:photo?candidate.source:null,rightsReviewed:false};
   })).then(entries=>{
     // Duplicate content can arrive from different URLs (or a flaky CDN).
     // Source URLs are not a valid uniqueness test; compare decoded output.
     const used=new Set();
     entries.forEach((entry,index)=>{
       if(!entry.image||used.has(entry.image)){
         entry.image=authoredChapterArtwork(id,index);
         entry.kind='original-generated-art';
         entry.source=null;
       }
       used.add(entry.image);
     });
     templatePhotoCache.set(id,entries.map(entry=>entry.image));
     templateAssetAuditCache.set(id,entries.map(({kind,source,rightsReviewed},index)=>({
        chapter:index+1,kind,source,rightsReviewed,sourceAttempted:!!sources[index]
     })));
     return entries.map(entry=>entry.image);
   });
 templatePhotoPending.set(id,job);
 try{return await job}finally{templatePhotoPending.delete(id)}
}
/* A small original, dependency-free GLB demonstration model.
   Not a licensed commercial headphone model or complete PBR asset.
   A valid binary glTF file is generated and embedded as project data. */
let demoGlbCache='';
function builtInHeadphoneGlb(){
 if(demoGlbCache)return demoGlbCache;
 // R9-03: original, redistributable parametric headphone demonstration.
 // Smooth closed curved surfaces replace the former five scaled cubes.
 // Four genuine PBR primitives share a single valid GLB binary buffer.
 const materials=[
  {name:'Ceramic shell',pbrMetallicRoughness:{baseColorFactor:[.20,.31,.35,1],metallicFactor:.46,roughnessFactor:.28}},
  {name:'Soft-touch cushion',pbrMetallicRoughness:{baseColorFactor:[.060,.085,.10,1],metallicFactor:.02,roughnessFactor:.81}},
  {name:'Brushed metal',pbrMetallicRoughness:{baseColorFactor:[.72,.77,.78,1],metallicFactor:.85,roughnessFactor:.27}},
  {name:'Acoustic mesh',pbrMetallicRoughness:{baseColorFactor:[.16,.19,.20,1],metallicFactor:.08,roughnessFactor:.66}}
 ];
 const sets=materials.map(()=>({p:[],n:[],i:[]}));
 const push=(mat,point,normal)=>{const a=sets[mat];a.p.push(...point);a.n.push(...normal);return a.p.length/3-1};
 const triangle=(mat,a,b,c)=>sets[mat].i.push(a,b,c);

   const N=ringA.length;
   for(let j=0;j<(closed?N:N-1);j++){
     const k=(j+1)%N;

 const normalize=(x,y,z)=>{const d=Math.hypot(x,y,z)||1;return [x/d,y/d,z/d]};
 // Smooth elliptic ear cups and soft rim rings: lateral axis = X.
 function cup(side,mat,cx,cy,cz,rx,ry,rz,segments=64,rings=24){
   let prev=null;const caps=[];
   for(let j=0;j<=rings;j++){
     const theta=.0005+(Math.PI-.001)*j/rings;
     const ring=[];
     for(let k=0;k<segments;k++){
       const phi=2*Math.PI*k/segments;
       const x=side*(cx+rx*Math.cos(theta)),
             y=cy+ry*Math.sin(theta)*Math.cos(phi),
             z=cz+rz*Math.sin(theta)*Math.sin(phi);
       const normal=normalize(side*Math.cos(theta)/rx,Math.sin(theta)*Math.cos(phi)/ry,Math.sin(theta)*Math.sin(phi)/rz);

 function tube(mat,path,radius,segments=12){
   let prior=null;

     const p=path[i],before=path[Math.max(0,i-1)],after=path[Math.min(path.length-1,i+1)];
     const tangent=normalize(after[0]-before[0],after[1]-before[1],after[2]-before[2]);

     const ring=[];
     for(let j=0;j<segments;j++){
       const angle=j*Math.PI*2/segments;const nx=u[0]*Math.cos(angle)+v[0]*Math.sin(angle),ny=u[1]*Math.cos(angle)+v[1]*Math.sin(angle),nz=u[2]*Math.cos(angle)+v[2]*Math.sin(angle);

 align4();

  scene:0,scenes:[{nodes:[0]}],nodes:[{mesh:0,name:'Headphone / original parametric study'}],

function r17UpdatePreviewNav(){
 const value=$('r17PreviewPosition');
 value.textContent=String(r17PreviewChapter+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+String(r17PreviewTotal).padStart(2,'0');
 $('r17PreviewPrev').disabled=r17PreviewChapter<=0;
 $('r17PreviewNext').disabled=r17PreviewChapter>=r17PreviewTotal-1;
 $('r17PreviewFilmstrip')?.querySelectorAll('[data-r17-chapter]').forEach(button=>{
  if(Number(button.dataset.r17Chapter)===r17PreviewChapter)button.setAttribute('aria-current','step');
  else button.removeAttribute('aria-current');
 });
}
function r17GoPreviewChapter(index){

  $('templatePreviewFrame').contentWindow?.postMessage({type:'motion-studio-preview-goto',chapter:index},'*');
}
$('r17PreviewPrev').onclick=()=>r17GoPreviewChapter(r17PreviewChapter-1);
$('r17PreviewNext').onclick=()=>r17GoPreviewChapter(r17PreviewChapter+1);
window.addEventListener('message',event=>{
 if($('templatePreview').hidden||event.source!==$('templatePreviewFrame').contentWindow)return;
 const d=event.data;
 if(!d||typeof d!=='object')return;
 if(d.type==='motion-studio-preview-state'&&Number.isInteger(d.chapter)&&Number.isInteger(d.total)&&d.total>=1&&d.total<=40&&d.chapter>=0&&d.chapter<d.total){

function r15MediaAudit(){
 const chapters=project.sections.map((section,index)=>({
  chapter:index+1,title:section.text,
  imagePresent:!!section.image,
  sourceKind:section.image?(section.imageMeta?.kind||'unknown'):'missing',
  sourceUrl:section.imageMeta?.source||null,
  rightsReviewed:false,
  fingerprint:section.image?String(section.image.length)+'-'+section.image.slice(-32):null
 }));
 const counts={total:chapters.length,photography:0,originalArtwork:0,userUploads:0,missing:0,unknown:0,duplicates:0};
 const seen=new Set();
 for(let i=0;i<chapters.length;i++){
  const item=chapters[i],raw=project.sections[i].image;
  if(!raw){counts.missing++;continue}
  if(seen.has(raw))counts.duplicates++;else seen.add(raw);
  if(item.sourceKind==='unsplash-photo')counts.photography++;
  else if(item.sourceKind==='original-generated-art')counts.originalArtwork++;
  else if(item.sourceKind==='user-upload')counts.userUploads++;
  else counts.unknown++;
 }
 const qualityHold=counts.originalArtwork>0||counts.missing>0||counts.unknown>0||counts.duplicates>0;
 return {schema:'motion-studio-media-audit-v1',templateId:project.templateId,
  title:project.title,counts,chapters,
  photoQualityStatus:qualityHold?'HOLD':'REVIEW_REQUIRED',
  commercialReleaseStatus:'HOLD',
  caveat:'Demo image licensing, recognizable people, brands and depicted works must be checked individually before commercial distribution. Imported files have not been independently rights-verified.'};
}
function renderAssetOverview(){
 const host=$('projectAssetList');if(!host)return;
 const audit=r15MediaAudit(),total=audit.counts;
 const coverage=$('r15MediaCoverage');
 if(coverage){
  coverage.innerHTML='<strong>素材覆盖率：'+(total.total-total.missing)+' / '+total.total+' 章</strong>'+
   '真实摄影 '+total.photography+' · 原创插画占位 '+total.originalArtwork+
   ' · 用户导入 '+total.userUploads+' · 来源未知 '+total.unknown+
   ' · 内容重复 '+total.duplicates+
   '<div class="r15-hold">商业素材验收：HOLD。照片来源和画面中的人物、品牌、艺术作品仍需逐张检查。</div>';
  coverage.dataset.photoQuality=audit.photoQualityStatus;
 }
 const entries=[];
 project.sections.forEach((section,sectionIndex)=>{
   if(section.image){
     const kind=section.imageMeta?.kind||'unknown';
     const provenance=kind==='original-generated-art'?'原创程序插画 · 非摄影素材'
      :kind==='unsplash-photo'?'Unsplash 示范摄影 · 权利待核查'
      :kind==='user-upload'?'用户上传 · 使用权待自行确认'
      :'来源未知 · 需要核查';
     entries.push({uid:section.uid,src:section.image,sectionIndex,kind:'section',
       label:'章节背景',title:section.text,provenance,sourceUrl:section.imageMeta?.source||null});
   }
   section.layers.forEach((layer,layerIndex)=>{
     if(layer.kind==='image'&&layer.src)entries.push({uid:section.uid,lid:layer.id,src:layer.src,sectionIndex,kind:'layer',label:'图片图层 '+(layerIndex+1),title:section.text});
   });
 });
 if(!entries.length){host.innerHTML='<div class="asset-empty">这个项目还没有图片。选择一个章节，在右侧上传图片后，这里就会自动显示。</div>';return;}
 host.innerHTML=entries.map((asset,index)=>`<div class="asset-entry"><img alt="素材预览 ${index+1}" src="${asset.src}"><div class="asset-entry-info"><strong>${safe(asset.label)}</strong><small>第 ${asset.sectionIndex+1} 章 · ${safe(asset.title.slice(0,24))}</small><small class="asset-rights-note">${safe(asset.provenance||'图片图层 · 权利待核查')}</small>${asset.sourceUrl?`<a class="r15-photo-source" href="${safe(asset.sourceUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">查看示范照片原始 CDN 地址</a>`:''}<div class="asset-entry-actions"><button data-asset-locate="${index}">定位</button><button data-asset-replace="${index}">替换</button></div></div></div>`).join('');
 function locate(entry){
   if(active!==entry.uid)selectSection(entry.uid);
   if(entry.kind==='layer'&&entry.lid!==activeLayer)selectLayer(entry.lid);
   const section=document.querySelector('.section[data-uid="'+entry.uid+'"]');
   section?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});
 }
 host.querySelectorAll('[data-asset-locate]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>locate(entries[Number(button.dataset.assetLocate)]));
 host.querySelectorAll('[data-asset-replace]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>{
   const entry=entries[Number(button.dataset.assetReplace)];
   locate(entry);
   const input=entry.kind==='layer'?$('layerFile'):$('propImage');
   if(!input){notify('未找到当前图片上传入口，请先解锁图层');return;}
   input.click();
 });
}

function addComponent(id,idx){const meta=registry.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!meta)return;if(project.sections.length>=40){notify('每个工程最多添加 40 个章节');return;}const s=normSection({id,text:meta.defaultText});if(Number.isInteger(idx))project.sections.splice(idx,0,s);else project.sections.push(s);active=s.uid;activeLayer=s.layers[0]?.id||null;render();notify('已添加 '+meta.title)}

function updateSection(k,v){const s=project.sections.find(x=>x.uid===active);if(!s)return;s[k]=v;const sec=document.querySelector(`.section[data-uid="${s.uid}"]`);if(k==='height'&&sec){sec.querySelector('iframe').style.height=s.height+'px'}if(['text','speed','depth','accent','motion'].includes(k)&&sec){const fr=sec.querySelector('iframe');fr.srcdoc=frameMarkup(getItem(s),s)}if((k==='imageFocusX'||k==='imageFocusY')&&sec){const art=sec.querySelector('.section-art');if(art)art.style.backgroundPosition=s.imageFocusX+'% '+s.imageFocusY+'%';}if(k==='image'){s.imageMeta={kind:v?'user-upload':'unknown',source:null,rightsReviewed:false}}if(k==='image'&&sec){let art=sec.querySelector('.section-art');if(s.image){if(!art){art=document.createElement('div');art.className='section-art';const frame=sec.querySelector('iframe');sec.insertBefore(art,frame||null);}art.style.backgroundImage=`url("${s.image}")`;art.style.backgroundPosition=s.imageFocusX+'% '+s.imageFocusY+'%';}else if(art){art.remove();}} if(k==='text'&&sec){const chapterTitle=sec.querySelector('[data-chapter-title]');if(chapterTitle)chapterTitle.textContent=s.text;}if(k==='text'&&sec){sec.querySelectorAll('.motion-layer').forEach(el=>{const layer=s.layers.find(l=>l.id===el.dataset.layerId);if(layer&&layer.kind!=='image'&&!layer.text)el.textContent=s.text.slice(0,55)})}if(k==='overlay'){refreshOverlays();}if(k==='image')renderAssetOverview();if(k==='text'){const nav=document.querySelector(`.timeline-node[data-uid="${s.uid}"]`);if(nav)nav.textContent=s.text.slice(0,28)||getItem(s).title}saveDraft();}

 ?'<!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>共享 Three.js 场景章节</title></head><body style="background:transparent;margin:0;font:15px system-ui;color:#e9f2e7"><div style="display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:400px;text-align:center;opacity:.7">共享 3D 场景正在加载。若 WebGL 不可用，请检查浏览器图形加速设置。</div></body></html>'

let previewComponentId=null;
function componentPreviewDocument(id){

 return frameMarkup(meta,normSection({id:meta.id,text:meta.defaultText,speed:100,depth:65,accent:'#d9ff67'}));
}
function openComponentPreview(id){

 if(!meta)return;
 previewComponentId=id;
 $('componentPreviewTitle').textContent=meta.title;
 $('componentPreview').hidden=false;
 $('componentPreviewFrame').srcdoc=componentPreviewDocument(id);
}
function closeComponentPreview(){

 $('componentPreviewFrame').removeAttribute('srcdoc');
 previewComponentId=null;
}
